originalTitle: Can Agnico Eagle Stock Bounce Off $151 Again?
summary: Today's big story: Reported SEC Probe: Could Nvidia Stock Fall To $92.
content:
Today’s big story: Reported SEC Probe: Could Nvidia Stock Fall To $92?

If you own Agnico Eagle Mines (AEM) , the past three months have been hard to watch . From August 24 to November 20, 2026, the stock lost 30.4% with dividends included, while the S&P 500 lost 9.5%. Yet the shares now trade at $151.30, a price where they bounced before. Will they bounce again, and what could a bounce be worth to you?

Agnico Eagle shares lost 30.4% in about three months. If much of your savings is in this single gold miner, a fall like that is hard to sleep through. Instead of one company, the Trefis High Quality (HQ) Portfolio owns 30 quality companies in equal amounts, and it is up more than 105% since September 2020. Look inside HQ .

Agnico Eagle Stock Has Bounced From This Price Before

Agnico Eagle stock closed near today’s price twice in September and October 2025, and both times it climbed. From $147.74 on September 2, 2025, it rose as much as 70.7% within a year. From $156.79 on October 28, 2025, it rose as much as 60.8%.

Those are the bounces that worked, and not every visit has. In the two years to November 20, 2026, the stock came back to this price range four times, and twice it rose 20% before it fell 5%. After a visit on June 10, 2026, it fell 5% first, closing at $143.51 on July 13. The latest visit, on November 19, has gone neither way yet.

The nearest strong resistance is $184.34, where rallies stalled twice before. A rise to that price would turn $10,000 put into the stock today into $12,180. A rise the size of the average of the two past bounces would turn the same $10,000 into $16,580. So the rise to resistance is smaller than either past bounce. One more level sits in the way, at $173.77, where a rally stalled once.

Is Agnico Eagle’s Business Strong Enough For A Bounce?

On its yearly results, yes. Agnico Eagle’s revenue grew 42.4% in the twelve months to September 30, 2026, above its 34.2% average across the last three such periods. Its operating margin rose each year, from 34.2% in the twelve months to September 2024 to 49.3% a year later. It reached 58.8% in the twelve months to September 2026, the highest at any quarter-end in data going back to late 2016. Yet the stock costs less for those earnings than a year ago. At the end of September 2026, it traded at 15.0 times earnings, against 24.6 a year earlier.

The latest quarters point the other way. Revenue growth, against a year earlier, slowed in each of the last two quarters. It fell from 66.1% in the March 2026 quarter to 17.1% in the September quarter. The operating margin slipped over the same quarters, from 62.4% to 55.6%. On the October 29, 2026 call, management said it expected 2026 production at the lower end of its guidance, and costs at the upper end. For a holder, the strong year is already in the results, but the business is now slowing.

How Far Agnico Eagle Could Fall If Support Breaks

Support breaks if the stock falls below $143.74. Below that, the next support sits 9.9% under today’s price, at $136.34. Two business problems could push the stock below it: rising costs and lower grade ore. Management said higher diesel prices could add as much as $80 an ounce to its 2026 costs, against its budget. At Detour Lake, its largest mine by revenue in 2025, mining has moved into lower grade ore, which holds less gold per ton. The company expects that to last through the fourth quarter.

Agnico Eagle plans its next guidance release in February 2027. Management said it will decide how much free cash flow to return to shareholders in 2027 and publish that with this release.

That release is still a few months off, and cash you are setting aside for these shares can keep earning while you wait.

chineseTitle: Agnico Eagle 股票能否再次反弹至 151 美元？
chineseSummary: 今天的大新闻：美国证券交易委员会 (SEC) 调查报道：Nvidia 股票是否会跌至 92 美元。
chineseContent:
今天的大新闻：据报道 SEC 调查：Nvidia 股票会跌至 92 美元吗？

如果您拥有 Agnico Eagle Mines (AEM)，那么过去三个月的日子很难熬。从2026年8月24日到11月20日，该股（含股息）下跌了30.4%，而标准普尔500指数下跌了9.5%。然而，该股目前的交易价格为 151.30 美元，这是之前反弹的价格。它们会再次反弹吗？反弹对你来说有什么价值？

Agnico Eagle 股价在大约三个月内下跌了 30.4%。如果你的大部分积蓄都花在这家金矿上，那么像这样的跌倒是难以入睡的。 Trefis High Quality (HQ) 投资组合不是一家公司，而是拥有 30 家同等数量的优质公司，自 2020 年 9 月以来增长了 105% 以上。看看 HQ 内部。

Agnico Eagle 股票之前曾从该价格反弹

Agnico Eagle 股票在 2025 年 9 月和 10 月两次收盘于今天的价格附近，并且两次都上涨。从2025年9月2日的147.74美元开始，一年内涨幅高达70.7%。从2025年10月28日的156.79美元开始，涨幅高达60.8%。

这些都是有效的反弹，但并非每次访问都有效。截至2026年11月20日的两年里，该股四次回到这个价格区间，其中两次上涨20%，然后下跌5%。在 2026 年 6 月 10 日的访问之后，它首先下跌了 5%，于 7 月 13 日收于 143.51 美元。最近一次访问是在 11 月 19 日，但两者都没有下跌。

最近的强阻力位是 184.34 美元，此前涨势两次在此停滞。如果价格上涨，今天投入该股票的 10,000 美元将变成 12,180 美元。如果上涨幅度达到过去两次反弹的平均值，那么同样的 10,000 美元就会变成 16,580 美元。因此，阻力位的上升幅度小于过去的任何一次反弹。还有一个阻力位是 173.77 美元，此前反弹一度陷入停滞。

Agnico Eagle 的业务是否足以实现反弹？

就其年度业绩而言，是的。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的 12 个月内，Agnico Eagle 的收入增长了 42.4%，高于过去三个时期 34.2% 的平均水平。其营业利润率逐年上升，从截至 2024 年 9 月的 12 个月内的 34.2% 上升至一年后的 49.3%。截至 2026 年 9 月的 12 个月内，该股的股价上涨了 58.8%，这是自 2016 年底以来任何季度末数据中的最高水平。然而，这些收益的股价成本却低于一年前。截至 2026 年 9 月底，其市盈率为 15.0 倍，而一年前为 24.6 倍。

最新几个季度的情况却相反。与去年同期相比，过去两个季度的收入增长均有所放缓。从 2026 年 3 月季度的 66.1% 下降至 9 月季度的 17.1%。同季度营业利润率从 62.4% 下滑至 55.6%。在 2026 年 10 月 29 日的电话会议上，管理层表示，预计 2026 年产量将处于指导值的下限，而成本则处于指导值的上限。对于持有者来说，强劲的一年已经体现在业绩中，但业务现在正在放缓。

如果支撑被打破，Agnico Eagle 会跌落多远

如果股价跌破 143.74 美元，支撑位就会被打破。在此之下，下一个支撑位为 136.34 美元，较今日价格低 9.9%。两个商业问题可能会导致股价跌破该水平：成本上升和矿石品位下降。管理层表示，柴油价格上涨可能使其 2026 年成本比预算增加每盎司 80 美元。按 2025 年收入计算，绕道湖 (Detour Lake) 是其最大的矿山，开采已转向低品位矿石，每吨含金量较少。该公司预计这种情况将持续到第四季度。

Agnico Eagle 计划于 2027 年 2 月发布下一次指引。管理层表示，将决定 2027 年向股东返还多少自由现金流，并在本次发布中发布。

该版本的发布还有几个月的时间，您为这些股票预留的现金可以在等待期间继续赚钱。
